last.verdict: Teva's branded drugs are growing fast enough to offset falling generics, and it raised its 2026 sales outlook again.

takeaways.label: Brands carry the quarter
takeaways.text: Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy together sold about $1.1 billion, up 33%. Total revenue still fell 2% to $4.4 billion on lower generic sales, mainly generic Revlimid.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook is now $16.7–17.0 billion, up from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo guidance rose to $2.55–2.65 billion from $2.45–2.60 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins and profit improving
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%. Adjusted EPS was $0.86 versus $0.78 a year ago. Free cash flow dipped 4% to $495 million.

takeaways.label: New long-acting schizophrenia drug
takeaways.text: The FDA approved Teva's monthly olanzapine injection on October 9. Teva targets $1.5–2.0 billion in peak sales for it and Uzedy combined.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
